text: Complaint Escalation and Nodal Officer Referral Document ID: SOP_C16_COMPLAINT_ESCALATION Category: C16 — Complaints & Grievances Department: Customer Care Customer Scope: all Version: 1.0 Last Updated: 2026-08-08 Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base Purpose To define the tiered escalation process for complaints exceeding standard resolution SLAs, aligned to TRAI's grievance redressal framework. Scope Applies to all channels and customer segments unless a specific exception is noted below. Preconditions Customer identity verified (registered number and OTP where applicable). Account is active and not under a fraud, legal, or compliance hold. Roles & Responsibilities Required Information Registered mobile number / account ID. Nature of the request and any reference numbers already issued. Relevant transaction or ticket ID, where applicable. Procedure Tier 1 (Customer Care): target resolution within 3-7 working days depending on complaint category. If unresolved at Tier 1 SLA expiry, auto-escalate to the circle Nodal Officer with full ticket history. Nodal Officer reviews and responds within 2 additional working days. If still unresolved, escalate to the Appellate Authority, and inform the customer of their right to approach TRAI/consumer forum if applicable. Decision Points If the request falls outside standard criteria, route for manual review before proceeding. If suspected fraud indicators are present at any step, halt standard processing and route per the Fraud & Security Response SOP. Exception Handling Cases outside standard scope require supervisor sign-off before proceeding. Validation Confirm the account/system reflects the expected end state before the case is closed, and obtain customer confirmation where applicable. Escalation Escalations beyond first-line resolution
title: Complaint Escalation and Nodal Officer Referral
